image_prompt: A slightly whimsical and humorous scene featuring a person wearing retro-futuristic glasses and an impatient, expectant expression, peering intently into a crystal ball that is completely empty, reflecting only their own face and a question mark. caption: Quem nunca quis dar aquela espiadinha no futuro, que atire a primeira pedra! 🔮 Mas a verdade é que ele ainda está no forno, sendo preparado.
